s.note: the battle on the plains of Wakanda
s.how: Grind 80g roasted peanuts with 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp ground ginger, chilli flakes and salt. Coat 500g thinly sliced rump and thread onto skewers. Grill hot and serve with sliced red onion and tomato.

s.note: Peter on the school bus over Queens
s.how: Pack lunch boxes with slices of 2 red apples, 150g cheddar cubes, water crackers and 100g pretzels. Have them ready to grab before the ship arrives over New York.

m.note: Thanos resting on his farm at the very end
m.how: Soften an onion with 2 tsp cumin. Add 800g diced pumpkin, 2 tins chickpeas and a tin of tomatoes with 500ml water and simmer 25 minutes. Stir in 100g baby spinach and serve with warm flatbread. A simple meal, perfectly balanced.

w.how: Make 4 packets of jelly in different colours, half quantities each, and set in rows of shot glasses. Top each with a little whipped cream. Collect all six.

d.how: Mix 600ml pineapple juice with the pulp of 3 passionfruit and 40ml grenadine. Pour over ice in four glasses and top with soda water. Wakanda forever.
